Bull, Departments I've run, it is more about not having the time or motivation to snoop through anyone's work. The teams only get involved when (1) we see a performance issue on the network or systems and need to investigate the sour or (2) a manager has come with some heavy justification as to why an investigation is needed.

In the latter case, it is expensive on team resources (IT teams are typically lean to start with, so they aren't typically bored enough to troll through a random person's traffic) and need to be passed through the gates of HR and Legal. It can be rather daunting and hence creates a huge barrier of entry. So, when a request does come it, it is usually pretty serious.
